metadata.title: Forecasting Inflation Without Looking Ahead
metadata.evaluation: one fixed origin, horizons 1 through 20; not 20 rolling one-step forecasts
metadata.interval_limit: normal innovations-only prediction interval; parameter uncertainty excluded

provenance.hash_algorithm: sha256 over schema and pandas row hashes (pandas version recorded)
provenance.hash_scope: model-input columns in positional row order; index labels excluded

optimizer.hessian: numerical (Ridders-extrapolated central differences of the analytic gradient of the concentrated log likelihood); sigma row analytic

resource_plans.scope: estimated live model-input and tensor buffers; excludes caller input, Python result objects, private BLAS workspace and allocator overhead; not a process-RSS limit
estimated live model-input and tensor buffers; excludes caller input, Python result objects, private BLAS workspace and allocator overhead; not a process-RSS limit

provenance.standardization: estimated on the outcome and regressors centered at their means (when the model has a constant) and scaled to unit variance; coefficients, covariance and log likelihood are reported in the original units
provenance.likelihood: exact Gaussian likelihood, stationary initial state (closed form of the Kalman-filter prediction-error decomposition)
provenance.fitted_values: one-step-ahead predictions of the outcome in levels; residuals are the one-step prediction errors (innovations)

inference.correction: observed information (OIM): numerical Hessian of the analytic gradient
inference.sigma: /sigma is tested one-sided against zero and its confidence interval is truncated at zero, as in Stata

model.label: Wald chi2 test that all coefficients except the constant are zero

ljung_box.label: Ljung-Box Q(8) test of the residuals

jarque_bera.label: Jarque-Bera normality test of the residuals

roots.convention: inverse roots (eigenvalues of the companion matrix); stationary / invertible when every modulus is below 1; seasonal roots are those of the polynomial in L^s
